notes.title: Developer Diary - May 2020
notes.notes:
In the past few weeks we've made some major progress on Sunshine Manor and now have the dialog system, mission system and plot pretty much nailed. 

Looking back on the comments and reviews that Camp Sunshine received it was obvious that we included way too many fetch quests, not enough action and that damned Bear could sneak up on you at any point ... Sunshine Manor changes this.

Sunshine Manor features a really nice twist on the survival horror game, and we won't outright spoil it yet but this little screenshot should give you a hint!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/22228751/8207bdbbd7686ecc3ff2c883095637c08663454e.png[/img]

We're very much hoping that we will be able to launch on Kickstarter later this year to help us to gather the funds needed to concentrate on the game full time (as we both work full time jobs at the moment too). So your help would be greatly appreciated!

notes.notes:
Over the years we've been asked "Why aren't you two on Patreon?" quite a lot. We always thought that Patreon was a place for people making regular content until one recent camper explained the whole thing to us and even helped us to set it up! 

So, we're now live on Patron ... here's the link!

[url=https://www.patreon.com/fossilgames]https://www.patreon.com/fossilgames[/url]

We're offering a load of unreleased stuff, music, behind the scenes looks at Sunshine Manor and even the chance to participate in the beta testing too!

See you there!

notes.title: Sunshine Manor - Dev Diary - November 2019
notes.notes:
We are hard at work on Sunshine Manor, and wanted to give you a sneak peek of the graphics direction we're taking with this second (or should that be first) chapter of the Sunshine Saga.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/22228751/4df3dc444213f7dba1587723ae3070ccc4b436b0.png[/img]

That's right, we're going full 8 bit with our graphics! Hopefully by now you know that we're two old school gamers and the thought of doing a full 8 bit title (with exception for maybe the music) is too fun to pass up. In our early tests a while back, we found that they gave off a far more creepy vibe and we're definitely playing around with this at the moment to give you a truly tense and terrifying experience.

Gone is the huge map of Camp Sunshine (complete with all of it's pre-loading issues) and you'll find yourself trapped in the titular Sunshine Manor and will be subjected to every twist and turn of the changing rooms and corridors as you power up the daemon engine ... oops might have said too much there!

Thank you for your continued love and support for this new chapter, and also for Camp Sunshine too.

notes.title: Introducing : Sunshine Manor
notes.notes:
Hello Campers ... it's been a while!

We haven't been idle though, far from it ... we have a little surprise for you coming late 2020.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/22228751/87d2a73653bce695d4cca5be080d655fa36e6b6b.jpg[/img]

Over the past few years we've spent time working on other titles, but none have captured our imaginations as much as the Sunshine Universe and the story of how it all began. 

All we can tell you is that this story takes place at the same time as Camp Sunshine but features an entirely new group of teenagers who spend the night in Sunshine Manor, the home of Clement Atkins, former children's television presenter in the 1950s. 

The game will feature an entirely new story, brand new soundtrack and we will be working as hard as possible to make this the most tense game we can possibly envisage. We would love to hear your suggestions, your story ideas and more!

This will be launching on Kickstarter later this year / early next year where we will show off the full trailer that showcases all of the goodies. In the meantime we will post here regularly with updates, announcements and also some very exciting news that's currently in the works!

notes.title: Update 1.3 - Egg-Cellent
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/22228751/5c38cf84f708b6ce38c75f48089ccd2c0f88c9fc.png[/img]

So Winter is well and truly over, and whilst we've been hard at work on our follow up game, we wanted to continue to support Camp Sunshine and we think you'll really like this little update. Here's what has changed ...

[h1]Crashing Bug[/h1]

[h1]Twigs[/h1]

Be careful around camp, we've moved the twigs and changed the way they work slightly. Step on one and Sunshine Bear will come running double-time!

[h1]Easter Fun[/h1]

A public holiday wouldn't be the same without a little update to Camp Sunshine, and the camp has had a new delivery. Now, the Easter Bunny has dropped it off somewhere around camp so get hunting and be prepared for some seriously annoying music and colour!

--


So there we go, as always if you have any problems with the game at all please e-mail us at hello@fossilgames.com and we'll help out as much as humanly possible!

Thank you all for the continued support ... we love each and every one of you :)

notes.title: 1.2 Winter Update
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/22228751/b0eb46c5cb4cdf34b2ff941e351e5432cfcfd507.jpg[/img]

Winter is coming ... where have we heard that before? Oh well, the Camp Sunshine winter update is now upon us! Here's what's been changed or updated ...

[h1]Winter Theme Updates[/h1]

You'll notice the first time you step outside during the winter update that it's now snowing around camp. But that's not all ... make sure you're nice to the snowmen that have suddenly appeared, you wouldn't want to be put on the 'naughty' list now would you?

[h1]Energy Drinks & Sunshine Bear[/h1]

We've also spent a great amount of time working on Sunshine Bear around the camp. You will run into him a little more often now, but you do have a new tool in your arsenal, and those are the Energy Drinks you've been collecting.

Now they don't just give you a little Stamina, they also speed Jez up to almost superhuman proportions for a few seconds so you can make a quick getaway should Sunshine Bear spot you, and give chase!

[h1]Quest Changes[/h1]

Not content with adding some cool new stuff, we also took a lookat some of the quests within the game and have made some cool little adjustments which makes the experience a little more tense and scary. We hope you enjoy them ...

[h1]Cabin Changes[/h1]

After watching quite a few videos and reading comments it became clear that a lot of the cabins weren't needed or didn't add anything more to the game. So we have took the steps to clean some of them up and even make other cabins bigger. Going upstairs in most cabins is also now a connected experience which means Sunshine Bear can chase you upstairs now too! Sorry about that! ːsteamhappyː

[h1]Boring Technical Stuffs[/h1]

We've also been tidying up the game and making things run a little smoother too, it's all boring technical stuff but rest assured it's better and doesn't give us nearly as many heart palpitations when we look at the code ːsteammockingː

So there we have it, we hope you enjoy this Winter Update as the Winter theme won't be around for too long! Remember, leave those Snowmen alone!

notes.title: Update 1.1 - Everything Happens for a Reason
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/22228751/fb6412e83f20ff44b929775f14ec65f493b35523.jpg[/img]

We’re delighted to bring you this new update which significantly changes the mechanics of some core elements of the game. We’re going to run down them all in this announcement … 

[b]PLEASE NOTE[/b] that some people may receive an error message when they update the game and try to load an older save. Unfortunately this is due to the new mechanics in every single cabin around camp and as such will cause some problems and as such may require a new save / play file. If you are having trouble please e-mail hello@fossilgames.com and we will do as much as humanly possible to assist you.

[h1]IT’S NOW BEAR-ABLE AROUND CAMP[/h1]

One of the largest bug-bears (are you bored of the bear puns yet?) we heard was that it felt far too random when Sunshine Bear decided to spawn and attack, and you were absolutely right! We took him back to the drawing board and worked every hour we could to give you a set of mechanics that would make Camp Sunshine even more enjoyable to play!

While Jez is outside of the Camp you will now be watched as to how you play. Take your time and Sunshine Bear will begin to learn where you are and could well pop-up and begin patrolling the area where you are. If he see’s you, he’ll give chase! 

You’ll be able to hear where he we have given him some padded footsteps in 3d audio so if you listen closely you’ll be able to tell which direction he’s coming from. He’ll also tell you when he’s found you, as he likes to brag about his hide and seek skills!

But don’t fear … all you need to do is get out of his line of sight or hide and if he loses your scent he’ll carry on looking for other campers to slaughter. Be warned, we’ve been a little more evil here and have placed some twigs and branches on the floor. Snap one of these when Sunshine Bear is nearby, and he will come-a-running!

[h1]WE PAWS-ED FOR THOUGHT ON THE INTERIORS TOO[/h1]

Ok ok ok, we’ll stop with the Bear puns now! 

Not content with re-working Sunshine Bear’s M.O around camp. We’ve also added a whole host of stuff when you are busy looting cabins.

Stay too long or make enough noise and Sunshine Bear could well arrive where you are. He will then begin patrolling the area looking for unwilling victims! Get into his Line of Sight and you could well be toast. 

The great thing here is that you can also run and hide inside too. Hide behind walls, wardrobes and bunk beds to stay out of his line of sight and you’ll be … fine?

[h1]WE COULDN’T BEAR YOU GETTING STUCK[/h1]

That’s the last one … it has to be!?!

During the story of Camp Sunshine you’ll be given a helpful little piece of jewellery that when used will guide you on your quest to locate all of the items. 

[h1]LET ME GET MY BEAR-INGS …[/h1]

Oh jeez, they’re still happening …

Also, all of your active quests will now show on the map. Showing exactly where you need to go in order to get those diary pages!

[h1]ADDITIONAL UPDATES[/h1]

* Added a note about Windowed mode to the controller diagram.
* Improved the semantics and formatting of the dialogue.
* Added more story too, thanks to your suggestions.
* Added a prize for completing a certain mini game

So there we have it … it’s a pretty big update and we hope you enjoy Camp Sunshine version 1.1. Thanks for bear-ing with us!

We have a lot more planned for Camp Sunshine, and the next update won’t be too far away! Keep ‘em peeled campers!

Not content with re-working Sunshine Bear’s M.O around camp. We’ve also added a whole host of stuff when you are busy looting cabins.

Stay too long or make enough noise and Sunshine Bear could well arrive where you are. He will then begin patrolling the area looking for unwilling victims! Get into his Line of Sight and you could well be toast. 

The great thing here is that you can also run and hide inside too. Hide behind walls, wardrobes and bunk beds to stay out of his line of sight and you’ll be … fine?

[h1]WE COULDN’T BEAR YOU GETTING STUCK[/h1]

That’s the last one … it has to be!?!

During the story of Camp Sunshine you’ll be given a helpful little piece of jewellery that when used will guide you on your quest to locate all of the items. 

[h1]LET ME GET MY BEAR-INGS …[/h1]

Oh jeez, they’re still happening …

Also, all of your active quests will now show on the map. Showing exactly where you need to go in order to get those diary pages!

[h1]ADDITIONAL UPDATES[/h1]

* You can now take a look at the map when you’re inside a cabin.
* Added a note about Windowed mode to the controller diagram.
* Improved the semantics and formatting of the dialogue.
* Added more story too, thanks to your suggestions.
* Added a prize for completing a certain mini game

So there we have it … it’s a pretty big update and we hope you enjoy Camp Sunshine version 1.1. Thanks for bear-ing with us!

We have a lot more planned for Camp Sunshine, and the next update won’t be too far away! Keep ‘em peeled campers!

notes.title: 1.1 Updates Announcement
notes.notes:
Firstly, thank you to everyone who has left a review for the game (positive and negative) we've been working since we launched to introduce a far better series of mechanics for Sunshine Bear ... here is what is coming soon!

[h1]Camp Spawn Mechanic[/h1]

We have heard from many players that the most frustrating thing is navigating the camp with a constant threat of the Bear spawning and slashing at you super fast. So we've wracked our brains and we think we've come up with a far better method of Bear operations. 

Now, when you are outside in the camp, Sunshine Bear will not spawn at all ...

What? We hear you cry ...

Well that's because he will [b]ALWAYS[/b] be there looking for you. 

We have a pretty great pathfinding algorithm in place for Sunshine Bear already, and we're putting this to the test around the camp. So be warned, Sunshine Bear will always be there ... are you ready?

He will de-spawn as he does now when he hits you. However, in hard mode - he won’t. You’ll be knocked back a few paces and then he’ll come after you again!

[h1]3D Spatial Audio in the Camp[/h1]

Now we have a killer bear being ever-present in the camp we also realised we need a way of telling you that’s he’s close by. So now you can hear him walking around and talking to anybody that will listen … the only trouble is you’ll only hear him when he’s close by. 

[h1]Softly, Softly, Catchy Jez-y[/h1]

Not content with taking a good long look at the Camp exterior. We’ve also tweaked how Sunshine Bear operates when he’s inside too. The semi-random nature has now gone and you are now being watched the moment you go inside … keep a low profile and you might be ok! Rush and clatter about and he’ll find you fast. 

The thing we’re happiest with is that Sunshine Bear now has a great line of sight mechanic meaning that he will only chase you when he can see you (and he'll tell you when he can). A great addition is also that you can now run around walls and bunk beds to get out of his line of sight where there's a chance he'll stop and continue his search of the cabin.

[h1]Other Update Notes[/h1]

* Added a note about F4 switching to windowed mode in the Controller diagram
* Improved the dialog semantics.
* Improved the story thanks to your suggestions!

Seriously, thank you all so much for your feedback. We truly appreciate it.

notes.title: Dev Diary - End of September 2016
notes.notes:
So we're now just over a month away from release and we're really happy with what we have in store for you at Camp Sunshine! Here's what has been achieved this month ...

[h1]Better Ending[/h1]
The ending of a game always has to be special, and we really think we've upped our game on this one. It's scary, tense and pretty darned hard! We've also been super careful not to let any information about the game ending leak, there's A LOT more to Camp Sunshine that meets the eye!

[h1]New Secrets[/h1]
By now (hopefully) you're aware that Camp Sunshine is littered with secret areas, quests, objects and more and we've just added one that we think is just pure fun ... i'm sure you'll take a "seat" and find it!

[h1]Revised Introduction[/h1]
We wanted a way to get players into the "action" as quicky as possible and now we think we've struck a nice balance. You're introduced to the game mechanics early on and then left to fend for yourself ... will your survive?


[h1]Full Controller Support[/h1]
This one has been on our "to-do" list for an absolute age and finally we've got it working exactly as we wanted. Now you don't have to use a keyboard if you would prefer a true 16-bit experience. Just plug in an xbox type controller and off you go ...

[h1]Soundtrack DLC[/h1]
The OST has now been uploaded to Steam and will be available to purchase on launch! A good portion of all funds received from sales of the Soundtrack go to benefit a great UK charity too!

So for the next two weeks it's polishing and a little more bug testing ... then it's almost time for the gates to open!

notes.title: Dev Diary - September 2016
notes.notes:
Good evening Campers, as September looms its head around the corner we're now just about 2 months away from release! We're into our final bug squashing phase at the moment and it's going pretty damn well!  Here's a little rundown of what we've done this month ...

[h1]Isaac Improvements[/h1]

Our new pathfinding is just superb, so if you're not hiding you should be! Isaac can now navigate his way perfectly to find you - you better hope you can get away from him pronto! 

We've also upgraded his appearance and disappearance sprites too, so he has lovely little animations as he lunges wildly to strike at you!

[h1]Full Controller Support[/h1]
This is something we would like to have finished and we are busy working on it to get it into the game so you can control your flashlight and toggle your map as you make your merry way around camp!

[h1]3D Spatialised Audio[/h1]
We're bloody delighted that the audio in the game is now fully realised in 3D. So you'll be able to hear the wonders of the camp as you progress through the game ... oh and the greatest thing is that when Isaac launches towards you, you know which direction to run!

[h1]More Creepy-ness[/h1]
Finally we've been adding in loads more little items and objects to really give you the creeps ... it's not going to be a fun ride! 

Thanks again for all of your support, it means such a lot ... i'll see you on the next one. In the meantime stay up to date with our Twitter :)

notes.title: Dev Diary - August 2016
notes.notes:
So July has come and gone and we're still foot to the floor making everything better, scarier and even more "fun" too! Here's what has been achieved ...

[h1]Difficulty System[/h1]
After multiple requests we have added a difficulty system into the game, so you are now presented with three scaling options of difficulty when you start your game. Be warned ... Hard mode is hard! ːsteammockingː

[h1]Sound[/h1]
The music has now been finished and we have a whopping 36 tracks for the game! All of them are absolutely superb and will be included as part of the OST DLC that has recently been added to steam. 

We're also busy in the foley studio at the moment recording additional audio for every object that can be found in the game (well, every object that could make a sound). As one of us is bit of an audiophile, expect this to be pretty cool ːsteamhappyː

[h1]Ending[/h1]
We also discovered the opportunity to making the game ending even better and wrap up the story in a really nice bow! We're so happy with the story, and we can not wait for you to delve into the history we've created. ːsteamhappyː

[h1]The Future[/h1]
August see's us continue with the audio developments, and then we're into round three of bug testing & fixing. But every day we're getting that little bit closer ... ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Dev Diary - July 2016
notes.notes:
With the first round of beta testing underway, we're over the moon with the game as a whole ... here's a rundown of what has been done, and you'll be glad to hear we're bang on track for our release date!

So here's what's been achieved in June ...

[h1]Isaac Improvements[/h1]

Isaac is now a not-so-lean mean slashing machine. We've really focused our efforts on making improvements to his pathfinding, and now he will happily hunt you down and kill you as long as you're not hiding. Remember, that if you're using your flashlight - he can see you easier too and will run as fast as possible towards you ... 

[h1]Backstory[/h1]

All of the backstory is 100% complete and we're really happy with everything we have so far. We're not finished the game, but we're really really close now! You're going to love it ... we hope!

[h1]Secrets[/h1]

Not content with adding in references to our favourite horror movies, we've also included a really juicy easter egg that (if you find it) will really give you a good test ... it's hard, but if you find it you'll be one of a small number who can boast about it to their friends!

[h1]Testing & Fixing[/h1]

We're now heavily into our bug testing and fixing and it's all coming along rather nicely! As usual we found a good amount of game-killers that have been fixed up and sent packing ... but it's almost there!

So soon you'll be able to come and stay at Camp Sunshine!
